method: Each starter at every major fight's level cap (Hardcore Mode) up to the Champion, evolved by level, with its best level-up moves and best nature, one-on-one against each boss Pokemon (rival fights use the team you would face); the first fights (caps 16 and 23) are also played out whole, the starter alone against their whole team (40 simulated battles each, no items). Overall = 40% the first fights + 25% the rest of the early game (caps to 36) + 35% the rest of the run.
